why: A package function called without parentheses is a call at any depth of packages: `b = kit.deep.fetch;` calls `kit.deep.fetch` (MATLAB doc 'Namespaces', 'Calling Functions': a function that takes no input can be called with no parentheses; project rule: a real call into the project is never hidden). With `+kit/+deep/fetch.m` deleted the call links nowhere, and with it back it links again. Each step must end where a fresh index ends (project rule).
